meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (Unitary National Jurisdiction, no sub-state tax differentiation)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 13 of 2011 (as amended by Act No. 13 of 2017); Financial Intelligence Unit Act No. 7 of 2011; International Companies Act Cap 222 (as amended, including beneficial ownership filing obligations introduced by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2015); Companies Act Cap 191; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act No. 20 of 1998 (as amended); VFIU AML/CFT Guidelines and VFSC Regulatory Directives on Beneficial Ownership.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed financial institution in the country of origin and the licensed Vanuatu registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (origin-country public notarization plus Vanuatu consular attestation)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing and corporate resolution of any corporate shareholder

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization through Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs or the nearest Vanuatu Honorary Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO disclosure schedule and corporate structure chart evidencing the 25% ownership threshold
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Applicant beneficial owners, certified by the licensed Vanuatu registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Verified and retained by the registered agent; notarized copies filed with VFSC on request

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all proposed directors, shareholders, UBOs, and authorized signatories against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, Australian DFAT consolidated sanctions list, and domestic Vanuatu sanctions designations under the AML/CFT Act No. 13 of 2011; foreign and domestic PEPs require enhanced due diligence (EDD), independent source-of-wealth verification, and senior management approval at the licensed registered agent; the medium-risk AML classification for ISIC 4651 wholesale semiconductor trading mandates ongoing transaction monitoring, periodic KYC refresh, and enhanced scrutiny of Swift-TT and escrow-inspection payment rails.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Company Name Search and Name Reservation Portal at https://www.vfsc.vu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be rendered in Latin-alphabet characters; English, French, and Bislama are official languages, and a name in any of these is acceptable. Non-Latin-script names (e.g., Chinese characters) must be transliterated into Latin-alphabet characters using the approved English/French spelling before submission. The name must contain as its last word or suffix an approved statutory identifier such as 'Limited', 'Ltd.', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', or 'Société Anonyme (SA)' in accordance with Section 5 of the International Companies Act Cap 222. Names that are identical, phonetically equivalent, or misleadingly similar to an existing registered name will be rejected.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant through its licensed registered agent must within 14 days of the VFSC rejection notice file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of International Companies at VFSC, attaching a formal objection memorandum, an alternative name list, and any ministerial or regulatory consent letters where applicable. The Registrar must issue a determination within 14 working days of the appeal. An adverse final administrative determination may be appealed to the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under the International Companies Act Cap 222 and the Vanuatu Court Procedure Rules. If a name is conditionally accepted, the initial 30-day reservation may be extended for one further 30-day period upon advance payment of the prescribed VFSC extension fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office is not acceptable as the statutory registered office. Vanuatu International Companies must maintain a physical street address in Vanuatu, being the office of a VFSC-licensed registered agent, at which service of process may be effected. For this non-licensed wholesale SSD/CPU trading entity, the back-office operations may be virtual or cloud-based, but the statutory registered office must remain a physical Port Vila address staffed during business hours by the licensed agent.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for the first year: estimated below 5% annualized probability for a non-licensed wholesale trading entity with a clean UBO and sanctions profile; however, the medium-risk AML classification raises the VFSC/VFIU targeted on-site inspection probability over a three-year window to approximately 10–15%, particularly if cash-equivalent payment rails or high-risk counterparty jurisdictions are identified.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [CAP 222] (Revised Edition 2009), esp. ss. 4–20 (incorporation and capacity), s. 5 (unrestricted objects), s. 19 (share capital), s. 55 (registered office and registered agent), s. 112 (board meetings and written resolutions)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry Division, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association accompanied by Form IC-1 (Application for Incorporation) and Notices of Registered Office and Registered Agent
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None. The Act imposes no minimum authorized or paid-up capital, and no escrow or capital deposit account is required prior to issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation; shares may be denominated in any currency and issued for such consideration as the first board determines.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT: (1) the allotment of one ordinary share to each initial subscriber, as recorded in the register of members, is hereby ratified; (2) the registered office at the address of the Company's licensed registered agent in Port Vila, and the designation of that agent, are adopted; (3) the persons named as directors and officers on the consent forms filed with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission are appointed, with full power to open bank accounts, sign trade contracts for wholesale brokerage of solid-state drives and server processors, and appoint sub-agents; (4) the directors are authorized to issue share certificates and take all ancillary actions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Availability Check and Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation application through the VFSC e-portal or in person using Form IC-0, proposing a name ending in 'Limited' or 'IC'. The registry conducts a conflict search to ensure the proposed name is not identical or deceptively similar to an existing registered entity and does not contain prohibited words.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of passport of the applicant subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, the applicant may file a new Form IC-0 with an alternative name, or lodge a written appeal with the VFSC Registrar within 14 days seeking administrative review of the refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent and the proposed subscribers
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a VFSC-licensed registered agent to draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English. The subscribers must execute the memorandum in the presence of a witness. The articles may adopt the standard model form with bespoke provisions for share classes, director powers, and indemnity clauses.
required_dossiers: Consent to Act as Director of each proposed director
Subscriber identity and address verification pack
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry returns the constitutional documents for correction, the registered agent cures the drafting defect within 14 days by amending the schedule and re-submitting clean executed copies.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application and Statutory Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge Form IC-1 together with the executed Memorandum and Articles, the Notice of Registered Office, and the Consent of Registered Agent. Pay the official VFSC registration fee of USD 750 (or Vatu equivalent) via bank transfer or in-person cashier. The registry issues the Certificate of Incorporation upon approval.
required_dossiers: Form IC-1 signed by each subscriber
Certificate of payment of registration fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried by the registry, the company has 21 days to respond to the deficiency letter; failure to cure may result in refusal, in which case a fresh application and fee credit are pursued through VFSC administrative appeal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Appointment of Registered Agent and Registered Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation, which states the incorporation date. The company must maintain a registered office and a licensed registered agent in Vanuatu at all times; the registered agent files a Notice of Appointment and confirms acceptance of service of process.
required_dossiers: Consent and Appointment of Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If issuance is delayed beyond the service standard, the applicant may request VFSC expedited processing (same-day service upon payment of the expedited fee) or escalate to the Registrar for resolution within five business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting, Share Certification, and Bank Mandate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors and corporate secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or adopt a written resolution, ratifying the issue of shares to subscribers, appointing officers, adopting the registered office, and approving the bank mandate instruction for corporate accounts. Issue certificates within one month of allotment and file the register of members with the registered agent.
required_dossiers: Bank mandate and beneficial ownership declaration (for AML onboarding)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a director fails to consent or a bank declines the mandate, the board may appoint a replacement officer by written resolution without re-filing with the VFSC, and the bank may be changed after written notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Customs Code, Economic Substance Notification, and Optional Business License Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Department; Port Vila Municipal Council; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: If the company will clear goods through Vanuatu or maintain a physical trading office/warehouse, register for an import-export customs code with the Department of Customs and Inland Revenue. Submit the annual economic substance notification to the VFSC if the company conducts 'distribution and service centre' activity. Obtain a municipal business license from the Port Vila Municipal Council if a physical premises is established.
required_dossiers: Passport copies of directors and officers
Lease or premises evidence for physical office/warehouse
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Customs and municipal registrations are ministerial; if refused, the applicant may submit a supplemented application or invoke administrative reconsideration before the Commissioner of Customs and the council registrar respectively.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No sectoral industrial licensing board applies to wholesale electronics trading; the relevant authorities are the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (offshore company oversight) and the Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (import/export registration).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable to a pure offshore wholesale brokerage model; an optional Port Vila Municipal Business Licence is required only if the company operates a physical office or warehouse in Vanuatu.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change and Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt (administrative registration only). ISIC 4651 wholesale trading of electronic components does not appear in the mandatory EIA trigger list under the Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations; no full EIA report is required absent physical manufacturing or waste-import operations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater or VOC emission points exist for brokerage-only operations. If warehousing is added, the operator must comply with the Waste Management Regulations regarding storage of electronic goods, prohibit import of WEEE/e-waste without a DEPC permit, and observe Basel Convention controls on transboundary movement of used electronic equipment.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Vanuatu Fire Service required for any occupied office or warehouse; structural load assessment by the Public Works Department only if a warehouse floor exceeds 200 m²; workplace clearance under the Employment Act [CAP 160] and the National Health and Safety Code, including registration of employees with the Vanuatu National Provident Fund and workers' compensation coverage.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Port Vila, Vanuatu; taxpayer and customs portal: ASYCUDA World / Vanuatu Customs Online (www.gov.vu, www.customs.gov.vu)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities obtain a Vanuatu International Company identification number from the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) rather than a national TIN. A DCIR VAT registration number is required only when the IC makes, or intends to make, taxable supplies in Vanuatu in excess of the VAT threshold, or voluntarily registers to zero-rate export supplies. The registration application is submitted to DCIR with the certificate of incorporation, VFSC extract, directors'/shareholders' identification and address proof, business licence (if required), expected turnover declaration, and evidence of activity; DCIR issues a VAT ID upon satisfactory verification.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election is available in Vanuatu. A foreign-owned International Company is outside the Vanuatu income tax base as a non-resident exempt entity. The only practical elections are voluntary VAT registration for exporters seeking input VAT recovery and the choice to operate entirely from outside Vanuatu so no local VAT, business licence, or customs nexus arises.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 4,000,000 of taxable supplies in any period of 12 consecutive months; voluntary registration is available for exporters.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time e-invoicing, fiscal clearance, API filing, or digital stamping regime is in force. Tax invoices must include the supplier's name and VAT ID, invoice date and number, description, quantity, amount excluding VAT, VAT rate and VAT payable. Exports are cleared through the ASYCUDA World customs electronic declaration; transport documents and commercial invoices must be retained as substantiation.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A registered VAT person may zero-rate supplies of goods exported from Vanuatu to a destination outside Vanuatu, and certain services performed outside Vanuatu for an overseas customer, provided the supplier retains evidence of physical export within the statutory period, the buyer is outside Vanuatu, and the goods are not retained for local consumption. For the semiconductor wholesale and brokerage model, zero-rating is available only where the goods move through Vanuatu customs under a valid export declaration and title passes to an offshore buyer; pure offshore-to-offshore brokerage without a Vanuatu supply remains outside the VAT net and does not require VAT registration.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration / SAD lodged in ASYCUDA World with export clearance stamp
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical departure from Vanuatu to the foreign buyer
Commercial invoice and packing list identifying SSD and server processor products, quantities, unit prices, and HS classification
Supplier VAT tax invoice and export certificate
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT credit / bank statement evidencing receipt of export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DCIR may audit export zero-rating and raise a VAT assessment at 12.5% on the export invoice, plus interest and penalties of up to 200% of the tax due, if documentary proof is missing, goods do not leave Vanuatu, or the transaction is found to be a sham. Customs misdeclaration penalties and VFSC licence suspension may apply; fraud may attract criminal prosecution and retrospective clawback of input VAT credits previously refunded.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), acting as exchange-control authority under the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 63] and as banking and payment-system supervisor under the Banks Act [Cap. 64] and the National Payment System Act 2022; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) administers the International Companies registry and licensing under the Financial Dealers Licensing Act.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu maintains a liberal convertible-currency regime: the Vatu (VUV) is independently floating, current-account payments are free from central-bank pre-approval, and capital-account repatriations are subject only to bank-level AML/EDD documentary review rather than statutory quotas. An International Company operating in offshore mode is exempt from exchange-control restrictions under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] provided it does not carry on domestic business in Vanuatu; consequently, profit remittance, dividend distribution, and capital withdrawal encounter no convertibility hurdles or profit-franking requirements. Practical friction is limited to correspondent-banking scrutiny: USD-clearing banks may impose enhanced review or fee surcharges on VUV/VU-flagged flows unless trade documentation, beneficial-ownership declarations, and purpose codes are complete and coherent.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender ratio, conversion timeline, or repatriation deadline applies to International Companies in Vanuatu. RBV retains statutory powers under the Exchange Control Act to direct domestic traders to convert export proceeds, but the IC is automatically exempt when it has no Vanuatu-source business, and USD, AUD, or EUR receivables may be retained indefinitely in the IC's operating account. Where the IC settles local expenses (registered-agent fees, VFSC filing fees, or legal retainers), the bank converts only the precise VUV-denominated amount at prevailing spot rates, leaving all trade balances in the original contract currency.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (USD, AUD, VUV multi-currency; escrow-capable sweep)
Operational Account (USD/VUV) with documentary collections and cash-backed LC booking
Domestic settlement account (VUV) — retail/government-oriented, unsuitable for trade flows

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium-Low — not viable as the sole treasury rail. Global EMIs (Wise, Payoneer, Airwallex) generally decline Vanuatu-registered International Companies due to limited local substance and offshore-style opacity; specialist APAC or UK EMI/PSP providers may offer USD/GBP/EUR IBANs, but high closure risk, elevated loading fees, and absence of LC or documentary-collection capability make them unsuitable for wholesale SSD/CPU settlement. Legal constraint: any EMI servicing the IC must hold a payment-institution license recognized in its home state; operating without such license would breach the Financial Dealers Licensing Act, and RBV-regulated banks will not establish nostro links to third-country EMIs absent FATF-compliant licensing and a formal PSP agreement.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is effectively mandatory at account opening: Tier-1 banks (ANZ, BSP, BRED) require a director or a locally licensed registered agent holding a board-issued power of attorney to attend an in-person KYC interview in Port Vila; no purely remote onboarding is offered for offshore ICs. Beneficial owners may delegate attendance to the registered agent, but compliance clearance is materially faster when the economic owner completes the physical interview, supplemented by a video call and notarized passport copies; a one-to-two-day Port Vila visit is therefore recommended.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore IC lacking any local economic footprint — no office, staff, or business records in Vanuatu — raising shell-company or pass-through structuring flags.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Evidence packet comprising: (i) VFSC International Company certificate and registered-agent certificate; (ii) register of members, directors, and secretary compliant with the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2014; (iii) beneficial-ownership declaration for every individual with ≥10% economic interest or control; (iv) a written commercial-rationale memo mapping the Vanuatu IC into the global SSD/CPU distribution chain; (v) audited or management financials of the entity and operating principals; (vi) board resolution on treasury mandates, signatory limits, and dual-approval controls.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Wholesale spot-market pattern — rapid purchase-and-resale of identical HS 8471/8473 goods to diverse counterparties within days and absence of long-term supply agreements.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Back-to-back trade dossier per shipment: supplier proforma invoice; customer purchase order; Incoterms-specified contract; ocean/airway bill or forwarder house receipt; pre-shipment inspection and quality certificate (SGS, Bureau Veritas, or AsiaInspection); evidence of title transfer; and a 12-month turnover forecast reconciled to requested transaction velocity and account capacity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Third-party payment red flags — wires to or from unrelated parties, freight-forwarder omnibus accounts, or crypto-linked counterparties; high value without predictable cargo movement.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank pre-approved inbound/outbound counterparty whitelist; invitation-triggered KYC packs for every beneficiary (registered name, jurisdiction, beneficial owner, license status); contract-linked payment schedule; invoice reference encoded in SWIFT narration (e.g., IC-2025-XXXX); and a written undertaking to reject any wire not matched to an executed trade document with transport evidence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Vanuatu correspondent-banking perception risk — USD clearing through U.S. or EU correspondent banks may attract enhanced sanctions and EDD scrutiny.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed bank sanctions/screening questionnaire; OFAC-compliant beneficiary attestation; HS 8471/8473 and ISIC 4651 goods classification with end-user confirmation for processors; five-year electronic document archive commitment; quarterly compliance reporting; prompt response to EDD refresh requests; and two professional reference letters from existing FATF-member banks.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder capital and pre-sale working capital should enter as SWIFT MT103 wires from the beneficial owner's own corporate or personal account in an OECD/G20 jurisdiction to the IC's USD operating account at ANZ or BSP. Each wire must include: beneficiary account number and IC registration number, ISO 20022 purpose code 'TRAD' or 'GOOD' with narration 'capital injection for wholesale semiconductor trading, ISIC 4651', and reference to the underlying capitalization resolution. The receiving bank will apply exchange-control record-keeping and may require: board resolution approving the capital call under the IC's constitutive documents; updated register of members evidencing share issuance; and source-of-wealth evidence for the remitting shareholder, typically six months of bank statements plus a contract of employment or prior-year tax assessment. Third-party or family-member contributions must be supported by formal loan agreements and equivalent EDD documentation; all receipts are reconciled against the capital table before any trading disbursement is permitted.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlement is executed through three reinforcing rails: (1) Swift TT (MT103) for open-account and escrow-inspection-anchored settlements to pre-vetted suppliers, with narration containing contract and invoice references; (2) Documentary Letter of Credit (MT700 issuance, MT707 amendments) established by ANZ or BSP against 100% cash cover — an IC will not obtain unsecured LC lines, but cash-backed LCs are issuable within two to three business days, enabling supplier-side mitigations (partial shipment, tolerance, inspection clause); and (3) Documents Against Payment (CAD/D/P) collection, under which the settlement bank releases title documents strictly against payment or acceptance, suitable for mid-value consignments and the Escrow_Inspection_Wire rail when release is conditioned on an inspection certificate. Every disbursement is executed on the bank's outward remittance instruction form with underlying contract, proforma invoice, transport document, and inspection certificate attached; records are retained for five years for AML/CTF audit.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable foreign-exchange forward (USD/VUV, AUD/VUV) with tenor up to 12 months, offered by ANZ or BSP against an underlying invoiced receivable or payable, requiring a completed exposure certificate and 10-15% collateral margin.

Offshore non-deliverable forward (NDF) on VUV booked through an international dealer with a Vanuatu-authorized or foreign-regulated bank, permissible only when physical VUV settlement is unavailable and the trade documentation evidences the hedged exposure.

Cross-currency swap (USD/EUR, USD/AUD) under an ISDA 2023 governing agreement with a licensed dealer and CSA collateralization, permissible solely to convert trade-financing liabilities or receipts of SSD/CPU transactions, not for speculative positioning.

Natural hedging strategy: denomination of all chip and processor supply and purchase agreements in USD, with no open VUV position except a pre-determined operating buffer of approximately 10% of monthly forecast expenses, thereby minimizing routine FX conversion and associated spread costs.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (International Companies Act [Cap. 222], s. 90) — restating the registered agent, registered office, directors, members, and any registered charges
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Port Vila
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 60 calendar days after each anniversary of the company's incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: The International Company and every defaulting officer are liable to a fine of up to VT 25,000 (approx. USD 220); persistent non-filing beyond 12 months permits the Registrar to strike the company off the International Companies Register and dissolve it, with its assets vesting in the Government of Vanuatu.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Renewal Fee — annual franchise payment to maintain the International Company's legal existence and good standing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Port Vila — tendered through the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Payable on each incorporation anniversary; settlement by the anniversary date preserves uninterrupted good standing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-payment attracts late penalty and suspension of good standing; continued default over 6–12 months results in administrative strike-off and dissolution of the International Company under the VFSC's register-maintenance powers.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory audit exists for Vanuatu International Companies; the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] imposes no audit or audited-financial-statement filing requirement irrespective of turnover, revenue, assets, or shareholder count. An audit arises only where shareholders resolve to require one or where a financier or counterparty stipulates certified accounts for wholesale semiconductor transactions.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory accounting framework is mandated for International Companies; where financial statements are voluntarily prepared for management, lender, or due-diligence purposes, IFRS is the prevailing convention. The company must nonetheless maintain books and records sufficient to explain its transactions and financial position (ICA s. 96).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vanuatu maintains no public UBO register; the licensed registered agent is the statutory custody point for beneficial-ownership records under the AML/CFT regime. Upon any share transfer, the transfer is recorded in the Register of Members and the agent's beneficial-ownership file is re-confirmed and updated; the Annual Return filed with the VFSC re-confirms, as of the incorporation anniversary, the current members and, through the agent's records, the ultimate beneficial owners.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 350 – USD 750 per annum for a licensed VFSC registered agent inclusive of registered office
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required by statute; where prepared for counterparty or finance diligence, a certified compilation or review ranges from USD 1,500 – USD 3,500

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax on International Companies; the International Companies Act (Cap. 222) grants a complete exemption to non-resident-owned ICs, and no income tax is levied on their offshore profits.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Total statutory exemption from income tax, capital gains tax, dividend withholding tax, and stamp duty on share transfers; ICs are not required to register for tax, file income tax returns, or obtain tax clearances; the only periodic state cost is the VFSC annual renewal fee paid via a licensed registered agent.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return applies to International Companies. The only recurring statutory filing is the VFSC Annual Compliance Declaration (Form 7), submitted electronically through the VFSC i-File portal by the licensed Registered Agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (VFSC compliance declaration and renewal fee); no quarterly or annual tax returns exist.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 30 days after each anniversary of incorporation; the Registered Agent must file and pay the annual renewal fee before the anniversary, with a grace period of up to 30 days before late fees accrue.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact legal name of the International Company and its VFSC registration number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the registered corporate name as shown on the certificate; non-resident beneficial owners need not be identified on the public filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Vanuatu maintained by the licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the registered agent's office address; the IC need not maintain any physical premises in Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, licence number, and contact details of the Vanuatu Registered Agent and the responsible compliance officer.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Registered Agent executes the declaration as statutory agent; non-resident directors may sign by power of attorney.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement of capital structure, confirming that no bearer shares are issued and that the register of members is held at the registered office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Indicate par value and issued shares; nominee shareholding arrangements must be disclosed to the Registered Agent for AML/CFT purposes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC has not transacted business with Vanuatu residents, has not held Vanuatu land, and has not engaged in licensed financial activities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For an offshore semiconductor wholesale and spot-brokerage business, confirm 'no local activity'; all trading is executed outside Vanuatu via SWIFT TT or escrow inspection wires.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Payment confirmation of the VFSC annual government fee.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The fee is paid in USD or Vatu by the Registered Agent on behalf of the IC; no tax return or tax computation is attached.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the annual declaration attracts an escalating late fee of VT 5,000 for the first month and VT 10,000 per month thereafter, up to VT 100,000; the Registrar may strike the IC off the register, and restoration requires a Court order and payment of all backfees. Knowingly false declarations render the IC and its officers liable to a fine of VT 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment for two years.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu levies no withholding tax on dividends, distributions, or liquidation proceeds paid by an International Company to its non-resident shareholders, irrespective of beneficial ownership.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No domestic withholding tax exists to be relieved. Where a foreign tax authority asserts source-state taxing rights over payments received from a Vanuatu IC, the payor or investor invokes the applicable DTA or TIEA through the foreign tax administration. Vanuatu does not issue tax residency certificates for ICs because they are not liable to Vanuatu income tax; the VFSC may, however, issue a certificate of good standing and incorporation to support double-tax relief claims.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory rate on outbound royalties, license fees, and interest remitted by an IC. Under the Vanuatu–Australia DTA (signed 2017), the source state may withhold up to 10% on interest and 5% on royalties, but Vanuatu itself imposes no domestic WHT on such payments; escrow interest on trade deposits held abroad is likewise tax-free in Vanuatu.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable — Vanuatu has no transfer-pricing legislation, permanent establishment threshold, or thin-capitalization rules; no Master File, Local File, or Country-by-Country reporting obligations apply to International Companies in Vatu or any other currency.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: No Economic Substance Regulations are in force in Vanuatu; nevertheless, an IC must maintain a registered office and records in Vanuatu, act through a licensed registered agent, and refrain from prohibited domestic business. In practice, substance is evidenced by board minutes, trade contracts, and payment flows held at the registered office. Foreign tax courts may apply their own CFC, GAAR, or sham doctrines where the IC lacks economic substance and is de facto managed from the beneficial owner's residence.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Cross-Border Tax Evasion and Treaty/GAAR Abuse
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Channeling semiconductor SSD/CPU wholesale margins through the Vanuatu IC to evade income tax in the shareholders' residence country while the IC lacks real substance; failing to file CFC or foreign-asset declarations; backdating invoices to shift profit from high-tax jurisdictions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Foreign revenue authorities may reassess profits, impose penalty interest and penalty taxes up to 200% of the tax avoided, and apply general anti-abuse rules under MLI/GAAR; the Vanuatu VFSC may also fine the IC VT 1,000,000 for knowingly filing false declarations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts may pierce the corporate veil and hold directors personally liable for restitution of evaded tax plus punitive civil penalties; serious cases trigger cross-border arrest warrants, travel bans, asset-seizure orders, and imprisonment of up to 7 years for tax fraud in the residence jurisdiction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Absence of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a letterbox IC with no Vanuatu bank account, no physical records, mail-forwarding only, nominee officers with no decision-making authority, and the beneficial owner exercising full commercial control of the wholesale trade from abroad.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC strike-off from the International Companies Register, cancellation of the certificate of incorporation, confiscation of the registered office, and fines up to VT 2,000,000; internationally, the structure triggers EU/AML risk-rating and termination of correspondent banking relationships.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The veil of incorporation is pierced for abuse of the corporate form; shareholders and directors become jointly and severally liable for the company's trade debts and foreign tax liabilities, face disqualification as directors for up to 5 years, and may be barred from re-entering Vanuatu pending regulatory investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving undisclosed cash or using alternative payment conduits for SSD/CPU chip settlement; failing to file Suspicious Transaction Reports with the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU); or using the IC as a corporate cloak to launder proceeds of fraud or customs evasion.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Financial Transactions Reporting Act (as amended) criminalizes money laundering with imprisonment of up to 10 years and/or fines of up to VT 10,000,000; the instrumentalities of the offence are subject to forfeiture, and a conviction triggers automatic revocation of the IC's registration by the VFSC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, officers, and beneficial owners who knowingly participate, consent, or are wilfully blind face personal criminal liability, confiscation of personal assets, cross-border travel bans, and extradition; corporate assets are frozen pending trial and disgorgement of profits is mandatory.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Prohibited Local Business and Unlicensed Financial Activity
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the International Company to carry on domestic Vanuatu business, hold an interest in Vanuatu land, solicit customers in Vanuatu, trade in Vatu-currency instruments, or act as a securities dealer or foreign-exchange broker without a VFSC licence — conduct ultra vires to the IC's statutory exemption.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Every prohibited transaction is void as against the State; the Registrar of International Companies may cancel the certificate of incorporation and impose a fine of VT 500,000 per violation; revenue derived from illegal domestic trade is subject to full recoupment and penalties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Each director who participated in a prohibited act is individually liable for all money received, damages suffered by third parties, and VFSC enforcement costs; the Court may order restitution, grant injunctive relief to the Registrar, and imprison defaulting directors for up to 2 years.
